name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited

facts.business: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited (APSEZ) is India's largest integrated transport utility company, operating ports across nine maritime states and union territories with a growing global presence, providing port operations, logistics, dredging, and marine services.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to incomplete/incorrect recording of services
Risk of services not recorded in correct period leading to over/understatement of revenue
Risk of incorrect/unbilled and unearned income recognition
Credit risk from counterparties not meeting obligations
Liquidity risk from contractual undiscounted cash flows maturity profile
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act, where applicable and details of such transactions have been disclosed in the standalone financial statements as required by the applicable accounting standards.
